v1.14.0 development plan. PHASED, dataset-driven, theme-leaning-E as of 2026-05-05.

UPDATE 2026-05-05: Phase 1 soak ran 12 days (Apr 23 → May 5). Mid-soak dataset analysis (audit/telemetry from 2 machines) surfaced strong signal pointing at a fifth theme not in the original four. Soak-only discipline relaxed because evidence is unambiguous. See docs/investigation-bootstrap-overflow-2026-05-05.md + docs/dataset-2026-05-05-findings.md.

PHASE 1 — SOAK (2026-04-23 → ~2026-05-14, ~3 weeks) [PARTIAL — data mined early]
Original signals to watch (still relevant for Phase 2):
- Empty-codex_get rate drops from 48% baseline (#92 core acceptance).
- aliasResolved reliably captured on codex_run + codex_copy (#93/#94).
- context.next_session picks up organic use (#91 adoption signal).
- Seed-quality lint holds 0 false-positives (#82).
- Topology pair counts emerge past zero (#83).

PHASE 2 — THEME PICK (~2026-05-14, but effectively decided by 2026-05-05 dataset)

Original four themes (still valid framing):
  A. Metadata maturity — #45, #84, #42
  B. Search / discoverability — #13, #43
  C. Distribution — #6, #49, #50, #51
  D. Polish / performance — #44, #47, #48

NEW: theme E added 2026-05-05 from soak findings:
  E. Guardrails / data hygiene — #99 (project-resolution refusal, root-cause fix), #100 (codex_context size budget), #101 (write-amp guard), #102 (audit project=. logging bug, small), #103 (tier semantics docs), pairs with #84 (entry health) already in milestone.

Why E is leading: the dataset shows the FA-iOS bootstrap-overflow incident is two stacked causes (silent project-resolution fallthrough + 4-7x write amplification on files.* keys). Same pattern reproduced on machine 02's CAS_robot store (well-tended, still hit cap edge). Miss-paths writeback rate 3.7% — the existing feedback loop is broken. These are correctness/UX bugs in production, not feature wishes.

Dataset bias rules (still apply):
- Metadata conversations → A.
- Agents struggling to locate entries → B.
- New-user onboarding pain → C.
- Response-time complaints → D.
- Bootstrap overflow / silent data routing failures → E. ← THE SIGNAL WE GOT.

Pick the theme anchor + ≤5 issues total. Trim rest to v1.15 backlog (unmilestone).

PHASE 3 — DESIGN + BUILD (~2026-05-15 onward, may start earlier on #99)
#99 is ready to design — root cause is well-understood. Follow the #91 playbook: design conversation → scoped plan → one feature per commit → tests → live verify → ship. #100 needs a budget-default conversation. #101 needs a warning-vs-blocking decision. #102/#103 are small, ship-anytime.

PHASE 4 — CI / INDIE ITEMS
#96 shipped via PR #98 on 2026-04-28 — Phase 4 is now empty.

RELEASE TARGET
No calendar date yet. Theme E is well-scoped (5 issues, three small) so v1.14.0 could ship faster than the 4-6 week original estimate. Don't over-commit — let #99 design pass set the pace.

DOGFOODING PART THREE
Expected alongside v1.14.0 tag. With theme E, the natural narrative is "the loop closed and showed us a hole" — soak data caught a problem the original four themes wouldn't have addressed.

ANTI-PATTERN WARNINGS
- Don't pre-commit to a theme before Phase 1 data. ← Honored: data arrived first, theme decided after.
- Don't let the candidate list sprawl past 5 shipped items.
- Don't skip the design pass on #99 — silent-fallthrough refusal is a behavior change with multiple write-tool surface area; needs the design-first treatment #91 got.
- Don't re-audit the bootstrap-overflow area without a new finding (issues #99-103 fully cover it as currently understood).
